- Read the two original deform weights before writing either normalized value. Change only DEF_A and DEF_B; do not normalize every group together because MASK must remain unchanged.
- Do not change positions, topology, transforms, materials, shape-key data, group names or modifiers. Do not call file-saving operators. Return the requested JSON-serializable modified-vertex count.
- Python's built-in len(sequence_or_collection) returns its number of elements; for example, len(array) or len(vector).

- The returned modified-vertex count counts vertices whose weights you actually changed. It is not automatically the total vertex count. Preserve the required result schema.
- Vertex IDs and group IDs are different: v.index identifies a vertex; group.index identifies a named vertex group. Each entry a in v.groups is an assignment object with group ID a.group and weight a.weight. To check membership, compare a.group with group.index, for example any(a.group == group.index for a in v.groups). Read a.group and a.weight as attributes; assignment objects are not (group_id, weight) tuples. Do not test integer membership with in on Blender collections or VertexGroup objects.
Return concise code and explanation in the required JSON object. Avoid long comments/docstrings and speculative APIs. No complete solution is provided by this reference.
